page-title.purpose: The tab's h2; focus lands here.

group-heading.purpose: Names a list of cards, with a muted count.

card-title.purpose: The Chore name or a section card's h3.

stat.purpose: A number over its label in a stat tile.

motion.name: colors-fast
motion.purpose: Button and chip colour changes, behind motion-safe only.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: A toast fades and slides down 0.5rem.

motion.name: skeleton-delay
motion.purpose: A skeleton appears only after this, so fast loads never flash.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action you are most likely to take on a card or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:2.75rem; min-width:2.75rem; padding:.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius:62.5rem; font:600 1rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary { background:#2f6f4f; border:1px solid #2f6f4f; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1a5fb4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action on a card.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius:62.5rem; font:600 1rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary { background:#fff; border:1px solid #6b7a73; color:#1c2421; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1a5fb4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Leaving a Home or other hard-to-undo actions; the thick edge carries meaning beyond colour.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius:62.5rem; font:700 1rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-danger { background:#fff; border:2px solid #b3261e; color:#b3261e; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1a5fb4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: A Category's icon and name on its pastel.
components.html: Kitchen
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:2rem; padding:.25rem .75rem; border-radius:62.5rem; border:1px solid #6b7a73; background:#fde3d0; color:#5c2e12; font:600 .875rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The one container: white, hairline edge, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { box-sizing:border-box; padding:1rem; border-radius:1.25rem; border:1px solid #6b7a73; background:#fff; color:#1c2421; font:400 1rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin:.25rem 0 0; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Full-width field, 1rem text so iOS does not zoom.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5rem .75rem; border-radius:.75rem; border:1px solid #6b7a73; background:#fff; color:#1c2421; font:400 1rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1a5fb4; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Four equal tabs, icon over label; the active one has a teal top edge.
components.html: TodayChoresHomeMe
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; background:#fff; border-top:1px solid #6b7a73; font:400 .875rem/1.5 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { flex:1; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5rem .25rem; text-align:center; color:#4d5a54; border-top:4px solid transparent; } .ds-tab-active { color:#2f6f4f; font-weight:600; border-top-color:#2f6f4f; }

narrative.overview: Homeowner looks like the advice it gives: quiet, plain and kind. It is opened on tired mornings, one-handed, on a phone, so every screen is a single centred column of soft rounded cards on a pale surface, read top to bottom. Nothing shouts. One teal voice marks the actions; six Category pastels label what kind of work a Task is; everything else is ink on paper.
keyCharacteristics: One centred column (max 32rem), mobile-first, no desktop layout.
Flat white cards with a 1px edge on a pale green-grey surface.
One teal accent for primary actions; pastels label Categories only.
Pills for buttons and chips, rounded squares for icon tiles, big rounded rectangles for cards.
Thumb-reach: no primary action is stranded on the left.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal means "this is the action". It never decorates, never labels a Category, and never appears on more than one button per card.

rules.name: The Pastels Name, Never Rank Rule
rules.body: A pastel says what kind of work it is, or, on an initials avatar, tells Residents apart. It is never used for status, urgency, success or Importance.

rules.name: The Calm at Every Number Rule
rules.body: A Streak of 0, an empty plan or a Drained day uses the same neutral colours as a good day. There is no alarm colour for rest.

rules.name: The Wrap, Never Truncate Rule
rules.body: Every text box wraps (overflow-wrap: anywhere). No ellipsis anywhere; the largest text size must still show the whole name.

rules.name: The Right Thumb Rule
rules.body: If the action you most want pressed is not at the bottom-right or full width, the layout is wrong.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Plastic Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If something needs to stand out, give it the accent tint or a pastel, not elevation.

dos: Do use semantic tokens only (bg-surface-raised, text-muted); a raw palette class compiles to nothing.
Do keep every touch target at least 2.75rem and every size in rem.
Do write the Category name, the Effort level and every status as text next to its icon or colour.
Do put the expected action bottom-right or full width (The Right Thumb Rule).
Do keep motion behind motion-safe: and under 200ms.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients on cards, or glass effects. The only gradient is onboarding's full-bleed welcome background.
Don't use teal for anything but the primary action and the active tab.
Don't use a pastel to mean status, urgency or success.
Don't truncate text with an ellipsis.
Don't use alarm colours, exclamation marks or countdowns for rest, empty days or a Streak of 0.
Don't put the action you expect people to take on the left edge of a card or dialog.
